rationale: The 2.3.6 Agent Mode guide requires Platform 10.1.x+, a supported AWS location and enabled Model Runtime; its CMP instructions additionally describe the Cloud Connected app minimum and certificate/8089 setup. Runtime distinguishes Frankfurt Data zone from Dublin Global and allows third-party processing. Cloud Connected installation and SAIA-9918 exclude the 2.2.0–2.3.6 range, offer 2.1.1 without Agent Mode, and describe 2.4.0 as planned. A feature-guide minimum or a base-assistant/IL2 listing supplies no currently usable CMP Agent Mode path or authorization.

exclusions: No native Cloud restriction, actual tenant availability, supported future release, entitlement or customer authorization is inferred.
